content.json:
# Thrift-Swap Board
Request count, error rate and response time for both services, and the SLO for `POST /swaps`. Every chart is built from the one log line each service writes per request.

content.query:
let target = 99.0;
let threshold_ms = 500;
ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where Log_s startswith "service=swaps "
| parse Log_s with "service=" service " method=" method " path=" path " status=" status:int " duration_ms=" duration_ms:real
| where method == "POST" and path == "/swaps"
| summarize total = count(), good = countif(duration_ms < threshold_ms and status < 500),
    p50_ms = round(percentile(duration_ms, 50), 1), p99_ms = round(percentile(duration_ms, 99), 1)
| extend achieved_percent = iff(total == 0, 100.0, round(100.0 * good / total, 3))
| extend target_percent = target
| extend slo_met = achieved_percent >= target_percent
| extend error_budget = toint(floor(total * (100.0 - target_percent) / 100.0, 1))
| extend budget_left = error_budget - (total - good)
| project total, good, achieved_percent, target_percent, slo_met, p50_ms, p99_ms, error_budget, budget_left
content.title: SLO: 99% of POST /swaps under 500 ms (last 7 days)

content.query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where Log_s startswith "service="
| parse Log_s with "service=" service " method=" method " path=" path " status=" status:int " duration_ms=" duration_ms:real
| where isnotnull(status) and path != "/health"
| summarize requests = count() by service, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
content.title: Requests per service

content.query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where Log_s startswith "service="
| parse Log_s with "service=" service " method=" method " path=" path " status=" status:int " duration_ms=" duration_ms:real
| where isnotnull(status) and path != "/health"
| summarize requests = count(), errors = countif(status >= 500) by service, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| extend error_rate_percent = round(100.0 * errors / requests, 2)
| project TimeGenerated, service, error_rate_percent
content.title: Error rate (5xx, %)

content.query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where Log_s startswith "service="
| parse Log_s with "service=" service " method=" method " path=" path " status=" status:int " duration_ms=" duration_ms:real
| where isnotnull(status) and path != "/health"
| summarize p50_ms = percentile(duration_ms, 50), p95_ms = percentile(duration_ms, 95), p99_ms = percentile(duration_ms, 99)
    by service, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
content.title: Response time (ms)

content.query:
let threshold_ms = 500;
ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where Log_s startswith "service=swaps "
| parse Log_s with "service=" service " method=" method " path=" path " status=" status:int " duration_ms=" duration_ms:real
| where method == "POST" and path == "/swaps"
| summarize total = count(), good = countif(duration_ms < threshold_ms and status < 500) by day = bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| extend achieved_percent = round(100.0 * good / total, 3)
| order by day asc
content.title: SLO per day

content.query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where Log_s startswith "service="
| parse Log_s with "service=" service " method=" method " path=" path " status=" status:int " duration_ms=" duration_ms:real
| where isnotnull(status) and path != "/health"
| extend endpoint = strcat(method, " ", replace_regex(path, @"/\d+", "/{id}"))
| summarize requests = count(), errors_5xx = countif(status >= 500), rejected_4xx = countif(status between (400 .. 499)),
    p95_ms = round(percentile(duration_ms, 95), 1), max_ms = round(max(duration_ms), 1) by service, endpoint
| order by errors_5xx desc, p95_ms desc
content.title: Endpoints: volume, failures, slowness
